decisions.label: Paraffin
decisions.description: A common name for a group of high molecular weight alkane hydrocarbons; a white, odorless, tasteless, waxy solid widely used as an embedding medium for tissue processing in histology.

verification.note: NCIT:C727 Paraffin; label omits 'wax' but the NCIT definition explicitly describes it as a waxy solid used in biological specimen preparation. Best available NCIT match for paraffin wax embedding medium.

decisions.label: Methyl Methacrylate
decisions.description: A methyl ester of methacrylic acid; a reactive resin used as cement in dentistry, orthopaedic surgery, and ophthalmology, and as a hard plastic embedding medium for electron microscopy.

verification.note: NCIT:C47615 Methyl Methacrylate; label specifies the methyl ester form rather than methacrylate in general. Methacrylate resin embedding typically uses methyl methacrylate specifically. Review recommended to confirm usage context.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.
